name: Ordinary Love
source:
You play as a young man caught in a web of secrets that could lead to the subjugation of those close to you. One day, you are afforded strange new abilities that might help protect the ones you love. Who will you choose to save? How will you stop those who wish to take advantage of the people you care about? Make your choice and strengthen the bonds of love in the city of Ordinary.

[From [url=https://statesville-games.itch.io/ordinary-love]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个陷入秘密网的年轻人，这可能会导致你身边的人被征服。有一天，你获得了一种奇怪的新能力，可能有助于保护你所爱的人。你会选择拯救谁？你将如何阻止那些想要利用你关心的人的人？做出你的选择，在平凡之城加强爱情的纽带。

[来自[url=https://statesville-games.itch.io/ordinary-love]Itch.io[/url]]
